initialize.instructions: Swiss public transport timetable with real-time delays, from the national timetable (opentransportdata.swiss), run by the association Opendata.ch. Times are Swiss local time (Europe/Zurich). Station names can be given as people say them ('Bern', 'Zürich HB', 'Lausanne, gare'); when a name is ambiguous, call find_stations first and use the exact name or id it returns. Addresses and places of interest work as start and destination of a connection too. Coverage is Switzerland (and border stations); for journeys abroad say that the data ends at the border. The timetable covers the days from a week ago to about three months ahead; nothing found for a date outside that range means no data, not no service.
